messages.content: Please hold the best recommendation for me in the audio category for user_id user_01, then add quantity 1 of the Sony XM5 in silver to my cart. For reference, I know the product_id I have is p_sony_xm5_blk. After that, check what coupons are available, including coupon_code SAVE15, and apply the best discount. Then generate an invoice for the discounted total and send the payment link to user_01@example.com. After that, complete an express checkout for that same item using payment_method credit_card with payment_gateway stripe, and finally remove the item from my cart.
